subject: Request: SOC 2 evidence package + Incident Response Plan for FinVar
messages:
From: Alex Pritchard <alex@finvar.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 evidence package + Incident Response Plan for FinVar audit

Hi Tessa,

FinVar is starting a SOC 2 readiness audit later this quarter and our security team asked me to collect a few items from vendors. Can you please provide the following by EOD Monday (48 hours):

- A copy of Redwood's incident response plan (redaction-friendly version is fine)
- A manifest of SOC 2 evidence for the last 12 months (control owners, artifact names, and a short description)
- SIG and CAIQ responses if available, or an index of which controls are covered and where to find answers
- Your primary point of contact for incident notifications and expected notification timelines

If you have a Drive folder or a short link with the above, that will work — we prefer an index that our auditors can reference. We may follow up with additional questions or a quick conference call if needed.

Thanks — we appreciate a timely turnaround.

Alex Pritchard
Security Program Manager
FinVar Co.
alex@finvar.com

Team — forwarding FinVar's request (below). They want the IR plan and SOC2 evidence manifest within 48 hours. Can we assemble a redaction-safe package and a one-page notification timeline?

Suggested breakdown:
- Vivek: please validate the IR plan (attached draft) and mark anything we should redact (customer-specific telemetry, internal IPs). Confirm that the IR plan publication date and SLAs are correct.
- Neha: export the SOC 2 evidence manifest (control -> artifact mapping) and SIG/CAIQ index; include Drive links where auditors can find artifacts.
- Marissa: you will be POC to FinVar for the handoff. Draft a short cover email that includes the notification timeline and our emergency contact details.

I attached a working draft of the IR plan (IR_Plan_Redwood_v2.pdf) and a skeleton manifest. We can iterate, then share the redacted final to the FinVar team.

Deadline: please have an internal review by Mon 2026-03-29 10:00 AM PT so we can turn it around to them. If there are blocking items (e.g., evidence retention gaps), flag them in-thread.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Pritchard <alex@finvar.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 evidence package + Incident Response Plan for FinVar audit

Tessa,

Thanks for the fast response. Two quick follow-ups while you prepare the package:

1) Our security operations team detected a run of anomalous API calls on Sun 2026-03-28 03:12:00 UTC that were authenticated using a FinVar service token. The requests originated from an IP range not seen previously for our traffic. We're trying to understand whether that activity correlates to any vendor-side event. Can you confirm whether Redwood experienced any security event, maintenance, or changed notification state around that timestamp?

2) If you did have an incident or service disruption, please provide the notification timeline your IR plan would follow (detection -> internal escalation -> customer notification -> mitigation) and the contact for out-of-band escalation (phone number).

Our auditors may need some of the same logs (request IDs or at least hashed identifiers) for cross-referencing. If you can't share raw logs, an indexed list of request IDs and a short description of impacted scopes will suffice.

Appreciate it — this is time-sensitive for our SOC 2 readiness.

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Pritchard <alex@finvar.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@finvar.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Post-incident summary, IR plan, and SOC2 evidence (redacted)

Alex / Maria — thanks for flagging the anomaly. Per our internal review and the artifacts below, here's the concise summary and package we can share with your auditors. Details that could reveal customer telemetry have been redacted; if you need additional context for incident correlation we can arrange a short secure call or provide hashed identifiers under NDA.

Summary timeline (high level):
- 2026-03-28 02:58 UTC — Unusual pattern of authentication attempts observed by FinVar (reported to FinVar SOC)
- 2026-03-28 03:05 UTC — Redwood automated detection flagged a small cluster of failed auths against a misconfigured service endpoint (internal)
- 2026-03-28 03:12 UTC — A subset of requests were accepted where token rotation had been delayed for a short window (root cause: replication lag in key management cache during routine deployment change)
- 2026-03-28 03:30 UTC — Mitigation: forced key rotation, revoked affected tokens, and applied a cache consistency fix to the KMS client (no data plane access observed)
- 2026-03-28 04:10 UTC — Notification: internal stakeholders and impacted customer POCs notified per our IR playbook

Impact: We found no evidence of customer data exfiltration or unauthorized data reads. The event allowed limited authenticated requests that were isolated to ephemeral control-plane operations.

Artifacts shared (redacted):
- IR_Plan_Redwood_v2.pdf — incident response plan (redaction-friendly)
- SOC2_Evidence_Manifest_Q1_2026.xlsx — control->artifact manifest with Drive links (access-controlled)
- postmortem_finvar_incident_2026-03-30.docx — post-incident analysis and remediation checklist

Related links:
- Evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/redwood/finvar-soc2-evidence
- Ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/ticket/55512345

If FinVar needs additional log correlation we can provide hashed request IDs and the minimal metadata (UTC time, request ID hash, affected endpoint) through the HubSpot ticket under the existing NDA. For urgent escalation, reach Marissa Cole (pager: +1-415-555-0199).

Next steps (recommended):
- We will schedule a short 30-minute call to walk through the postmortem details and answer auditor questions (propose Tue 2026-03-31 10:00 AM PT).
- We will update the public IR FAQ with the timeline and lessons learned in the next 72 hours.

Apologies for the inconvenience and thank you for the quick heads-up — this helped us identify and close the replication gap faster. Please let us know if you require any additional redactions or a dedicated secure channel for follow-up.

Regards,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0186
E: tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com
